certificate.description: The Ciena Corporation Waveserver 5 Control Processor Module is a multi-chip embedded hardware cryptographic module. The module is a purpose-built field replaceable unit intended for operation within the Ciena Waveserver 5 chassis. Its primary function is management of the Waveserver 5 chassis, which includes one or more Waveserver 5 Encryption Modules.
